verdict.rationale: Unit documents a native ledger with real-time balances and transaction data, and has a Webhook Events docs page. The evidence does not show balance reads that reflect holds or pending activity, and it does not detail which transaction state changes fire webhooks. Missing for 10: documented available-vs-current balances including holds and pending, webhook event catalog covering every transaction state change, details on registering webhooks and delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the ledger is real-time and event-driven — balance reads that reflect holds and pending activity, and webhooks for every transaction state change so my system mirrors the bank exactly

citations.quote: with real-time balances and transaction data
They run on a unified infrastructure and native ledger
